meaning:
(Qal) to be hoary, be gray
Aramaic equivalent: siv (שִׂיב "be gray" H7868)

renderings.kjv: With us are both the grayheaded

elsewhere.note: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
